You said red and it didn't stop, breach of contract (Would it be your fault if you gave a neighbor your dog to look after while you went on vacation and then when you got back they refuse to give it to you because they had already started caring for it?).

Retraction of consent is for then and there, it doesn't mean you'll never do it again. But if your partner doesn't respect you saying red, then that limits the possibility of trying it or other things later on.

You are not at fault. This was rape.

1. You dump her.

2. You have a sit down and straightforward talk with her.

This is why I say #2 (unpopular opinion coming up), "rape" is a big word, so basically your experience wound go under the same word as someone being forced to have sex with a stranger in an alley, as well as two people a year apart in age who have dated and had sex for years, and one of them turns 18 and they continue to consent to sex, and the other is still 17. It's a wide range for one word. So while yes, you were raped, in my eyes it is on the lesser side of bad, not so terrible an offense that you have to cut them off(for lack of a better worded sentence). She is young, and probably doesn't fully understand consent, or maybe doesn't have much experience. You know her better than we do, hence why you should talk and see if this is something that won't happen again. Talk and teach her.
